description: Preserve conversation context by sending cd_recall_line when switching worker programs mid-thread in OpenAgents Desktop.

steps.send: When switching between Antigravity CLI (agyworker) and Microcoder (mcworker) mid-thread in OpenAgents Desktop (`apps/openagents-desktop/Window+Runs.swift`), `launchWorker` stops the old worker and starts the new one without sending `cd_recall_line` unless `recallDue` was already set. Update `launchWorker` so switching worker programs (`switchedProgram`) always sets `sendRecall = needsRecall || switchedProgram` and replays completed turns to the new worker. Verify syntax with `swiftc -parse apps/openagents-desktop/Window+Runs.swift`.

graders.run: swiftc -parse apps/openagents-desktop/Window+Runs.swift && grep -q 'switchedProgram' apps/openagents-desktop/Window+Runs.swift && grep -q 'sendRecall' apps/openagents-desktop/Window+Runs.swift
